objective: Validar despues de la restauracion runtime que el job protegido sync_comercial_abiertas_v2 vuelve a ejecutarse automaticamente sin modificar su codigo. Confirmar nuevas ejecuciones VENTAS_DIA posteriores a 2026-09-28T21:57:34Z, cinco sucursales y ausencia de pausa/lock. Etiqueta: Sincronizador.

queries.name: ventas_dia_latest_runs
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (30) run_id,run_timestamp,run_type,unidad_negocio_id,fecha_inicio,fecha_fin,status,error_message,source_connection_status FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 WHERE run_type='VENTAS_DIA' ORDER BY run_timestamp DESC

queries.name: ventas_dia_new_after_restore
queries.sql: SELECT run_id,MIN(run_timestamp) AS inicio,MAX(run_timestamp) AS fin,COUNT(*) AS registros,SUM(CASE WHEN status='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exitosos,SUM(CASE WHEN status<>'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_exitosos FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 WHERE run_type='VENTAS_DIA' AND run_timestamp>'2026-09-28T21:57:34' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY fin DESC

queries.name: ventas_dia_snapshot_freshness
queries.sql: SELECT unidad_negocio_id,sucursal_id,fecha_operacion,snapshot_timestamp,sync_run_id,total_estimado_dia FROM dbo.Comercial_Ventas_Dia_Abiertas_v2 ORDER BY unidad_negocio_id,sucursal_id

queries.name: ventas_dia_stale_lock
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (10) SyncRunID,SyncType,Status,StartedAtMexico,FinishedAtMexico,ErrorMessage FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones WHERE SyncType='VENTAS_DIA' AND Status='IN_PROGRESS' AND FinishedAtMexico IS NULL ORDER BY StartedAtMexico
